remaining_limits: This is orchestration/source-binding verification with fake model protocols, not a measured proof of semantic entailment. Independent review itself can be wrong; the separately owned real-source evaluation remains required.
Reviewer input/output caps may leave later claims unknown; warnings/unknown denominators are retained. Four sources and40 reviewed claims cannot guarantee support for every requested skill.

The2judge+1review cap applies to the new skill-matching branch. Mixed legacy points can still use existing legacy query expansion/reranking, as preserved for compatibility; those are not GET calls or extra claim-review retries.
